description: This file defines the implementation of command-line flag handling for ADB configuration in the Cuttlefish project. It includes a class AdbConfigFlagImpl that manages ADB mode flags, processes command-line arguments, and generates help XML. It also sets up dependency injection for the flag component.

classes.name: AdbConfigFlagImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the AdbConfigFlag interface, managing ADB mode flags, processing arguments, and generating help XML.

methods.name: AdbConfigFlagImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ADB mode flag and sets up getter and setter logic.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the flag implementation.

methods.name: Dependencies
methods.description: Returns dependencies for this flag feature.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes command-line arguments to configure ADB modes and connection.

methods.name: WriteGflagsCompatHelpXml
methods.description: Generates help XML for the flags.
